stages.name: Freeze
stages.purpose: Pin exact main SHA, release config, public policy URLs, performance/mobile contracts, and required credentials without changing gameplay scope.

stages.name: Certify
stages.purpose: Run exact-SHA production certification, backend financial-truth checks, desktop/mobile E2E, and preserve low-tier mobile performance.

stages.name: Package
stages.purpose: Generate Capacitor Android shell, inject unique Play versionCode/versionName, API 36, camera/mic permissions, build APK/AAB, sign AAB, and verify signature.

stages.name: Store Gate
stages.purpose: Verify Play Console readiness, policy/deletion URLs, developer/package registration attestation, and require exact-SHA iPhone + Android device proof before production.

stages.name: Publish
stages.purpose: Upload the signed AAB to the selected Google Play track with release notes; testing tracks can publish directly, production requires an explicit release confirmation.

stages.name: Proof
stages.purpose: Emit a durable release proof artifact with SHA, version, selected track, stage results, Play edit ID when available, and post-release monitoring handoff.

graphicsReleaseRule.lowTierMobile: Keep phone shadows disabled and preserve mobile performance contracts; improve art via geometry, materials, textures, LODs, animation and streaming rather than expensive real-time shadows.
graphicsReleaseRule.premiumPath: Higher-capability devices may gain richer quality through device-tier rendering after the alpha baseline remains playable.

playConsoleManualPrerequisites: Google Play developer identity verification complete
Package online.tryamm.app registered/created in Play Console
Google Play Android Developer API enabled
Service account invited to Play Console with app release permissions
For the first API-driven release, the Play app/package must already exist and be associated with the developer account
IARC, Data safety, privacy policy, app access and store listing declarations completed before production review
productionRequirements: exact main SHA is live at tryamm.online
iPhone device certificate artifact for exact SHA
Android device certificate artifact for exact SHA
